{{Quote|If we'd been a little later taking off, or if our hyperdrive hadn't been tuned just right, we would have missed it.|Denlan talks about the coordinate transmission|<ref name="Razor's Edge" />}}
'''Denlan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Denlan served as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Gamble]]'' during a mission to acquire supplies for use in the completion of the new Rebel base, [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the [[Starship/Legends|starship]], which had highly jury-rigged controls, alongside [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Esrai]], under the command of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vanden Willard/Legends|Vanden Willard]], bringing the vessel to the uninhabited [[Eschaton system/Legends|Eschaton system]] were the it was to receive the coordinates at which to meet their suppliers. After receiving the coordinates however, Esrai noted a approaching signal on the ships [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. The signal was that of an Imperial [[Imperial Customs Corvette|Light corvette]], which fired on the ''Gamble'' damaging it and causing the bridge's control console to explode. The explosion tore a hole in Denlan's chest and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him, which Organa discovered when checking his body shortly after. Whilst on the mission Denlan and the rest of the crew made sure not to wear [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] that would identify them as Rebels.<ref name="Razor's Edge" />

==Behind the scenes==
Denlan first appeared in ''[[Razor's Edge]]'' by [[Martha Wells]], released in [[2013]] as the first book in the ''[[Star Wars: Empire and Rebellion]]'' series of novels.
